evidenceStatus: Every numerical value in this catalog is an explicit illustrative modeling assumption, not a measured treatment effect.

government.label: Representative democracy
government.description: Elected representatives with competitive removal and institutional checks.

government.label: Direct democracy
government.description: Citizen voting on major decisions with delegated administration.

government.label: Constitutional monarchy
government.description: Hereditary ceremonial head with elected government and constitutional checks.

government.label: Absolute monarchy
government.description: Hereditary executive authority with limited institutional removal.

government.label: Aristocracy
government.description: A small hereditary governing council; social class policy is a separate decision.

government.label: Oligarchy
government.description: A small wealth-selected governing group; no mandatory economy or class option.

government.label: Meritocratic technocracy
government.description: Leaders selected by assessed competence; assessment can fail and authority remains contestable.

government.label: Personalist autocracy / tyranny
government.description: Personal executive control with weak removal and review mechanisms.

education.label: Public comprehensive
education.description: Broad publicly funded access and a general curriculum.

education.label: Mixed public and private
education.description: Public provision with regulated private alternatives.

education.label: Subsidized private education
education.description: Private provision with public subsidies and household fees.

education.label: Vocational emphasis
education.description: General schooling with a larger vocational and apprenticeship component.

education.label: Centralized prescribed curriculum
education.description: Uniform state curriculum and centralized staffing.

reproduction.label: No state reproductive direction
reproduction.description: No state direction of reproductive choices.

reproduction.label: Voluntary family planning
reproduction.description: Voluntary reproductive healthcare and informed choice.

reproduction.label: Voluntary family incentives
reproduction.description: Financial and care support for families; no compulsory reproduction.

reproduction.label: State-directed reproductive restrictions
reproduction.description: High-level comparison of coercive reproductive control. No assumed genetic improvement; enforcement and autonomy harms are represented.

censorship.label: Minimal censorship
censorship.description: Narrow restrictions on directly unlawful conduct with independent review.

censorship.label: Targeted content restrictions
censorship.description: Defined content restrictions with an appeals process.

censorship.label: Political censorship
censorship.description: Suppression of political criticism and independent reporting.

class_system.label: No legally enforced classes
class_system.description: Equal formal standing; income differences can still emerge.

class_system.label: Mobile occupational hierarchy
class_system.description: Occupational ranks with routes to change status.

class_system.label: Legally privileged groups
class_system.description: Legal advantages for a restricted group.

class_system.label: Hereditary classes
class_system.description: Inherited legal status with restricted mobility.

defense.label: Small professional force
defense.description: Standing professional defense with training and equipment costs.

defense.label: Citizen militia
defense.description: Reserve training and civil defense; substantial part-time participation.

defense.label: Conscription
defense.description: Mandatory service with opportunity costs and broader mobilization.

defense.label: Defense agreement and local guard
defense.description: Paid agreement with an external partner; availability and reliability are contextual inputs.

economy.label: Market-oriented economy
economy.description: Private production, limited transfers, and competitive markets.

economy.label: Mixed economy
economy.description: Market production with public services and moderate redistribution.

economy.label: Social market economy
economy.description: Competitive production with larger transfers and social insurance.

economy.label: Cooperative emphasis
economy.description: Worker and community ownership with income compression.

economy.label: Centrally planned economy
economy.description: Central production allocation and extensive public provision.

religion.label: Secular state
religion.description: No official religion and equal formal protection.

religion.label: Established religion with freedom
religion.description: Official religion with protected freedom for other beliefs.

religion.label: Multiple recognized religions
religion.description: Public recognition and support for multiple communities.

religion.label: Compulsory state religion
religion.description: Mandatory religious conformity with enforcement and exclusion.

food.label: Import-led food supply
food.description: Low domestic production and strong dependence on trade.

food.label: Local conventional agriculture
food.description: High domestic production subject to land, labor and weather limits.

food.label: Controlled-environment production
food.description: Present-day greenhouses and protected cultivation; higher capital and energy requirements.

food.label: Diversified local production and imports
food.description: Mixed domestic supply and trade with maintained reserves.
